status: user-authorized exploratory training despite the prior 8% CPU funding gate failure
teacher: Best of full heuristic baseline and two 8192-step bridged searches from it: mixed-decoder and non-delay, temperature 0.001, seed 29. Labels are feasible observed schedules, not optimal schedules.
training: Separately train GNN and MP-OFF from identical features and labels, two initialization seeds 101 and 102, 20 epochs CPU, offline W&B; choose epoch by validation complete-plan job completion.
features: Both learned arms receive processing, eligibility, current host/rank, lock/type and fixed 1/2/4-hop hand-graph columns. GNN alone updates hidden states along predecessor, successor, lock and host edges.
serving: A predicted complete placement/rank is planned under both non-delay and reservation decoders. Keep the better of model and full hand initialization, then run identical bridged search with the remaining portion of a 250 ms wall budget. Compare with hand search, MP-OFF and the unbudgeted finite reference.
claim: A GNN win requires positive paired median and interval against each MP-OFF draw and the hand control, plus the whole learned decision path within 250 ms. Two training draws and sixteen test environments are exploratory and cannot establish a powered general model-class claim.
live_gate: Run every selected GNN and MP-OFF plan, hand control and reference plan on all sixteen sealed test inputs in actual HeROsim: 96 runs, 24576 operations; independent operation and event audits must pass regardless of offline model quality.
